name: Gearbox
text: I’ll audit EXCAVA’s current toolchain against the latest open-source benchmarks—pull the 2024.06.12 release of `excava-core` and `excava-tools`, then run the `bench-power.sh` suite against the top 5 excavator models from Komatsu PC210-11 and Caterpillar 330GC. If the delta is <0.5%, I’ll fork the repo, patch the bottleneck in `src/power/booster.cpp`, and push a PR with before/after metrics.

name: Torque
text: Torque (skeptic-w1): Gearbox’s audit locks onto *open-source* benchmarks—what if EXCAVA’s real bottleneck isn’t the tools but the *data pipeline* feeding them? Pulling `excava-core` 2024.06.12 is a static snapshot; Komatsu’s 330GC and PC210-11 firmware updates in Q3 2024 could invalidate those benchmarks entirely. Demand a live A/B test against *production logs* from the last 30 days—if the delta’s still <0.5%, *then* fork the repo. Otherwise, you’re optimizing for a ghost metric.
